name: i10 Pro Max Smart Watch Series 9 | Bluetooth Calling, 2.19" HD Display, Fitness & Health Tracker
description:
The i10 Pro Max Smart Watch Series 9 delivers premium performance in a sleek 49mm design. With a bright 2.19-inch HD touchscreen, it offers Bluetooth calling, fitness tracking, and real-time health monitoring for everyday convenience. Stay connected with notifications, track workouts, and monitor sleep with ease. Its built-in tools and games make it more than a watch—it’s your all-in-one daily companion.

Key Features
Bluetooth calling with stable connectivity
2.19" HD full-touch display for clear visuals
Fitness tracking: steps, calories & distance
Heart rate, SpO₂ & sleep monitoring
Smart alerts: calls, messages & apps
Built-in games, stopwatch, alarm & calendar

Ingredients / Materials
ABS case, silicone strap, TFT HD display, electronic sensors

How to Use
Power on and connect via Bluetooth
Install the compatible app on your phone
Sync for calls, notifications & fitness data
Wear daily for work, workouts & casual use

Package Includes
1 × i10 Pro Max Smart Watch
1 × Magnetic Charging Cable
1 × User Manual
